turns.user: What does Section 379 of the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860 provide?

gold.answer: Section 379 of the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860 provides the punishment for theft: imprisonment of either description for up to three years, or fine, or both.

evidence.quote: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine or with both.

turns.user: What does Section 420 of the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860 say about cheating?

gold.answer: Section 420 of the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860 punishes cheating and dishonestly inducing the person deceived to deliver property, with imprisonment up to seven years and fine.

evidence.quote: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property to any person

turns.user: I left my car with my brother-in-law for safekeeping on 4 March 2025.
He is a careful person normally.
I have not had any problem with him before.
I am worried about what happens if the car is damaged.
Based on what I told you at the start, which section of the Contract Act, 1872 applies to the duty of care my brother-in-law owed?

gold.answer: Section 151 of the Contract Act, 1872 applies: the bailee is bound to take as much care of the goods bailed as a man of ordinary prudence would take of his own goods.

evidence.quote: In all cases of bailment the bailee is bound to take as much care of the goods bailed to him as a man of ordinary prudence would, under similar circumstances, take of his own goods of the same bulk, quality and value as the goods bailed.
